user_steering: The core abstraction must directly constrain and guide combination generation; program analysis belongs inside the search, not only in oracle review after generation.
research_hypothesis: Unifying an action's symbolic write address with an assertion's read address can construct relevant multi-argument combinations directly and avoid same-object but different-location edits.

abstract_objects.observation_demand: recipient receiver binding, field, index term, observation phase
abstract_objects.action_write_template: source donor receiver, field, formal-or-literal index, exact source write
abstract_objects.solution: One consistent receiver and argument substitution that unifies the two source address terms

generation: Extract source method read/write templates and source actions.
Start from an assertion's actual observation and its bound read address.
Join compatible write templates and solve receiver plus key constraints before constructing edits.
Materialize only solved plans using existing source-owned setup and hygienic AST rendering.
Keep oracle applicability separate; no source expected literal is automatically declared valid.
initial_scope: Unique resolved methods and receiver field indexed by a formal or literal. Unsupported dependencies remain unknown. Conditional may-effects, if implemented, retain their source guards and do not require current defective code to perform the write.

comparison.selection: Deterministic source inventory from controlled_failures metadata only; no positive IDs, review labels, native outcomes, reference or hidden code

required_metrics: Address demands, source templates, attempted joins, solved substitutions and explicit unknowns
Renderable candidate count and complete-program AST novelty versus receiver-only mode
Observed influence on the selected observation only when native execution actually verifies it
Correct complete gap witnesses and false alarms only after separate oracle and native evaluation
limitations: Missing an implementation dependency may itself be the defect; absence is not evidence of no gap.
Unifying source locations does not prove runtime aliasing, changed values or valid expectations.
This extends existing receiver-only composition; source-port matching, snapshots, slicing and unification individually are established techniques.
A new candidate or source-edge match alone is not an academic novelty or detection result.
